verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair axis for a database and its cloud console, but the evidence never shows CockroachDB generating AI insights or suggestions from user data. The MCP server only lets external AI tools query clusters, vector indexes are developer building blocks, and the resource-usage diagnosis docs describe manual optimization rather than AI-generated suggestions. None of these count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
